track_record.note: Per screener.in (FY23-FY26): revenue growth >=10% and ROCE >=17% each year, but off a very small base (revenue Rs 5.66 Cr FY22 -> Rs 54 Cr FY26) and pre-IPO figures are DRHP-sourced (SME IPO Oct 2025).
